name: Crown of Power shortens Melt Reality's tick interval by a quarter (#3582)
contract: Crown of Power 805854's tooltip reads "Increases the tick rate of Melt Reality by $s1%." In Spell.dbc it is a single SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (108) with EffectMiscValue 19 (SPELLMOD_ACTIVATION_TIME), EffectBasePoints -26 + DieSides 1 = -25%, EffectSpellClassMask [0,512,0], which inside SpellFamilyName 28 selects Melt Reality (503895-503899, 572835, 806335) and nothing else. Melt Reality 503895 carries EffectAmplitude 4000 on both its SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_DAMAGE effect and its SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL effect, and its duration is fixed (DurationIndex 325), so a shorter interval means more ticks. AuraEffect::CalculatePeriodic applies SPELLMOD_ACTIVATION_TIME straight to m_amplitude (SpellAuraEffects.cpp), giving 3000 ms. Generic core machinery. This scenario is a regression guard for behaviour that already works. The client renders $s1 as -25, so the shipped tooltip says "by -25%"; that is a text artefact, not a server defect.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
